bugs.description: Date inconsistency in fallback messaging: turn 4 bot said 'primera fecha válida es el viernes 12 de junio', but turn 5 returned Saturday 13th slots only (no Friday slots). Turn 6 confirmed Friday is fully booked. The initial Friday mention may be an artifact of next_available returning Friday as first-available but check_availability then finding it full — creates confusing UX ('Friday' then 'actually Saturday').

Over max_turns: scenario completed in 10 turns vs expected max_turns=8. The policy gate + name collection added 2 extra turns. This means for any scenario requiring policy acceptance on a new customer, max_turns=8 is systematically too low. The booking itself succeeded, but the turn budget is underestimated in scenarios-v2.yaml for new customers.

observation: Bot handled the no-availability fallback naturally — did not frustrate or dead-end the user. It proactively offered alternatives (next available Saturday) without the user having to pull for them. The Friday inconsistency is cosmetic but worth fixing. Main structural issue is the turn budget for new-customer flows.
